sections.heading: Who I Am
sections.body:
My name is Chase Kinghorn, and labels have never been my thing. Saying things like “artist” or “business owner” puts us in a bit too tight of a box, and it just can’t capture who we are as a whole. If I had to put it in one sentence I would say I’m primarily a lifelong learner, someone pursuing excellence in art, psychology, health, and my own self.

I love what I do, and I truly believe in it because not only do I have my own coach, but for every client I speak with, we find a way to change their life for the better, no matter what their challenge or goal is. It’s such a fulfilling feeling that I started off doing this for free just to hone in my skills and learn.

Despite my nerdy interest in systems thinking and organizational psychology, I’ve been a tattoo artist in my free time for many years, and when I can, I love making leather goods like bags and notebooks. I’m also an avid thrill-seeker, I love rock climbing, scuba diving, skydiving, cliff jumping, really anything that gets your heart pumping.

sections.heading: Mutare Mores Systems
sections.body:
*Progress is the priority.*

This business was created for the purpose of helping creatives and leaders utilize behavioral psychology and systems thinking to make their work more efficient, effective, and creative.

In a world where people hate consultants for not providing lasting change, while also hating coaches for not helping create answers, I strive to use the best of both worlds. I want to provide meaningful, personal, lasting change to you or your team, while still giving you my knowledge to help you create answers. It’s coaching and consulting rolled into one.

Your goal or challenge is what determines how much consulting vs coaching is needed. If the problem is internal (your habits and thought patterns), we’ll go a bit more into coaching.

If the problem is more structural or involves multiple people, we might need a bit more from the consulting side like assessments, analyses, and testing.

I’ve had people book a call for one issue to then go and sign the contract for a whole separate issue they didn’t know they even had. Conversations are powerful, you just have to ask the right questions.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body:
- The interesting part of my background starts when I moved to Bogota, Colombia, for 3 years in high school. I learned Spanish, met tons of cool people, and had some even cooler experiences.
- From there, I came to Florida International University, where I got my bachelor’s in industrial-organizational psychology (after switching from being an advertising major). I then went straight into my master’s to get a graduate degree in the same subject.
- During my first year of college, I also joined the Army National Guard, where I had originally planned to be an officer, but instead went on a year-long deployment to the Middle East. Super fun times.
- During the last semester of my masters, I got an internship (and later, job) at a local credit union, where I was able to build my skills in coaching, training, and organizational development all on my own, learning a *lot* in the process.
- In my last year of the National Guard, after over a year of consistent physical (and mental) training, I went to Special Forces Assessment and Selection, where I got to finally pursue what had been my dream for the previous 6 years. Long story short, I got injured in the final days and was unable to continue, but I’m very grateful because it has sent me down this path instead.
- I then went on to create Mutare Mores, my way to put a positive influence in the world and use my skills, knowledge, and experience to help leaders and creatives around the world become better at what they do.
- Ever since, I’ve been continuously working to improve the business and my own skills, always looking to create a bigger impact.

sections.heading: Current Goals
sections.body:
- Long term / ongoing
  - Grow Mutare Mores into a community of creative leaders who love to learn
  - Travel and live abroad
- Short term
  - Create more clients working on unique and important projects
  - Build my digital garden to at least 100 entries before 2027
  - Further refine my own personal systems and routines
